furnishing.body: <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bell" class="size-4 shrink-0" /> Scheduled publishing is now available on every plan.

examples.label: Cookie consent bar pinned to the bottom
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-banner" site="Global" id="banner-cookie-consent" vertical_position="bottom" border="none" padding="small" >
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shield-exclamation" class="size-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

Cookies on this site

Essential cookies keep your cart and your sign-in working. Analytics cookies tell us which guides people actually finish, so we can write more of them. Nothing is ever sold to advertisers.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/privacy" variant="transparent" color="natural" size="small"> Read the policy <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="outline" color="natural" size="small"> Essential only <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="button" variant="default" color="primary" size="small"> Accept all

examples.label: Seasonal sale bar with promo code and CTA
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-banner" site="Global" id="banner-spring-sale" variant="default" color="primary" padding="small" >
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bolt" class="size-5 shrink-0" />

Spring sale — 40% off every annual plan. Use code SPRING40 at checkout. Offer ends 31 March.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/pricing" variant="default" color="white" size="small" rounded="full" > Claim the discount

examples.label: Scheduled maintenance notice with status page link
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-banner" site="Global" id="banner-maintenance-window" variant="default" color="warning" padding="small" >
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-wrench" class="size-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

Scheduled maintenance this Saturday

Dashboards and the public API will be read-only from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC while we move the database to new hardware. Scheduled exports will run again as soon as the window closes.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/status" variant="default" color="white" size="small" > Follow the status page

examples.label: Product update card in the bottom-right corner
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-banner" site="Global" id="banner-release-notes" vertical_position="bottom" vertical_size="medium" position="bottom_right" position_size="medium" border_position="full" rounded="large" rounded_position="all" padding="medium" class="max-w-sm" >
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bolt" class="size-4 shrink-0" />

Version 3.4 is live

Timeline view for every project, search that is three times faster, and comments you can resolve without ever leaving the board.

examples.label: Permanent staging environment warning strip
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-banner" site="Global" id="banner-staging-environment" variant="default" color="dark" hide_dismiss={true} >

Staging environment — orders placed here are not real and the database resets nightly at 03:00 UTC
